In [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]], an '''attack on Supreme Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]''' at the hands of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Qui-Gon, suppose I could arrange for you to meet with Chancellor Valorum, so you could apprise him of these matters personally?|Adi Gallia|<ref name="CoD" />}}
[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] had reason to believe that Captain [[Arwen Cohl]] had survived the [[Dorvalla Incident]] and aired his concerns to fellow [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] who suggested the two confer with Supreme Chancellor Valorum.<ref name="CoD" />

==The attack==
{{Quote|The Supreme Chancellor is in danger. We need to hurry.|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="CoD" />}}
The two Jedi arrived to spot Chancellor Valorum engulfed in a crowd of media correspondents and his personal aides. As they approached the crowd, Jinn sensed that something was not right, and that moment was when the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] arrived in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] to attack Valorum. Jinn and Gallia fended them off but one succeeded in wounding Valorum.<ref name="CoD" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|You've heard who's to blame for what happened?''"<br />"''Only that the Nebula Front appears to have been involved.|Com Fordox and Palpatine|<ref name="CoD" />}}
In the moments following the attack, Valorum was rushed to hospital. Some believed that it was in retaliation of the Front not being included in the recently proposed [[Eriadu Trade Summit]]. Master Jin eventually found a Front base at [[Asmeru/Legends|Asmeru]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] and headed there with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentice, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and five other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="CoD" />
